correctness.rationale: PASS: With 0<K<n and orthonormal [G B], Gaussian convolution of X=G eta+B xi (xi|eta~N(0,I)), r|X~N(X,sc²I), Z|r~N(r,sb²I) gives Z|eta~N(G eta,(sb²+sc²)I+BB^T) with eigenvalues s and s+1. The paper Eq.(2.5) instead says a scalar covariance. Since B^T Z=xi+isotropic Gaussian noise, Cov(B^T Z,xi|eta)=I and mutual information=(n-K)/2 log(1+1/s). Conditional survival likelihood depends only on X, so integrating r yields p(Z,t,delta|X)=p(t,delta|X)phi(Z;X,sI); any positive variance pair summing to s induces the same joint observed likelihood after integrating X. Boundary K=0 or K=n excluded and different observation mechanisms excluded. Independent verification checks the Gaussian covariance eigenvalues [2,3,3] and singular two-scale information; proof is analytic.
